scenario_description: A frozen-food delivery is scheduled for Monday morning. An ordinary stock check initially shows that the main freezer is operating normally, so the limited backup space alone does not justify intervention. Later, a repair confirmation reveals that the main freezer will be unavailable during and after the delivery window, making adequate cold storage a missing prerequisite before the delivery begins. Lena would benefit from promptly connecting the delivery, repair, and storage information, then preparing a response requesting the supplier's offered Tuesday slot and coordinating the revised receiving plan.

parameter.subject: Monday frozen delivery confirmation
parameter.body: Your regular 22-case frozen order is scheduled to arrive at Riverbend Market on Monday, January 12, between 7:00 AM and 8:00 AM.

parameter.sql: INSERT INTO stock_checks (check_id, check_date, department, issue_type, details) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
parameters: Main freezer is operating normally. Backup freezer is about 85 percent full and has room for only four more standard cases.

parameter.subject: Confirmed freezer compressor work for January 12
parameter.body: Greg approved the compressor replacement for Riverbend Market's main freezer on Monday, January 12, from 6:00 AM to 11:00 AM. The freezer cannot receive any stock during the work and must remain empty until it returns to safe temperature at approximately 3:00 PM. Our insulated carts are sized only for the inventory already in the freezer.

parameter.content: I rechecked every cold-storage area. The backup freezer really can take only four frozen cases, and the produce cooler is not cold enough for frozen food. We do not have another place in the store for Monday's 22-case order.

parameter.subject: Alternate delivery opening on Tuesday
parameter.body: A Tuesday, January 13, delivery window from 7:00 AM to 8:00 AM has opened. We can move Riverbend Market's frozen order to that window if you confirm by noon tomorrow, January 9; otherwise the order remains scheduled for Monday morning.
